run.note: Historical baseline before structured-price recovery and quota circuit-breaker fixes. No secret or raw HTML is stored.

diagnosis: SearchApi secret was accepted and the structured source returned candidates before quota exhaustion.
Legacy price guard removed provider price fields before the V2 adapter recovered them, so valid_price_rate stayed zero.
The free monthly SearchApi quota was exhausted during the acceptance and diagnostic runs; the provider then returned HTTP 429.
Source-level failures were incorrectly counted as case system errors in this baseline.
repairs_after_run: Recover SearchApi extracted_price and currency before common V2 normalization.
Prefer direct retailer product links over Google aggregation links.
Classify HTTP 429 as RATE_LIMITED and expose the sanitized provider reason.
Add a process-local circuit breaker so one quota response stops repeated provider calls.
Separate case system errors from partial source errors in acceptance metrics.
Add a SearchApi account/quota preflight before manual acceptance workflows.

next_live_gate.requires: SearchApi quota reset/upgrade or SERPAPI_API_KEY fallback
